title: The standard exercise target was never the ceiling.
deck: Minutes of moderate exercise a week where the heart-risk curve flattens

statement.flag: About three and a half hours
statement.detail: More minutes tracked with lower heart-disease risk up to the mark — past it, the curve ran flat.

_provenance.paper: doi:10.3389_fendo.2026.1844167 · An et al. 2026, Front Endocrinol (Lausanne) · prospective cohort (UK Biobank), n=88,281, median 7.29y

claims.quote: Overall, LPA and MVPA exhibited nonlinear L-shaped relationships across stages 0-3, with overall inflection points at 2,357 (95% CI: 2335-2379) min/week for LPA and 213 (95% CI: 207-219) min/week for MVPA.

_provenance.why_not_sweep: Only the inflection point is grounded; no curve values survive grounding, so a sweep would require inventing the L-curve's y-values. Narrow renders the one number honestly: the band closes onto 213 and the remaining width IS the 95% CI.
_provenance.note: No pin at the 150-min guideline: 150 traces to no claim, so it stays off the asset. The caption names it, explicitly attributed to guidelines.
